task: Port the upstream story dossier page into packages/graph and add a --story=<id> flag to the graph command that deep-links to it.
outcome: Running proof-or-stop graph --story=B-xxxx opens a browser on the dossier page for that story at /story/B-xxxx; an unknown id is refused before the server listens; the dossier is also reachable from a button in the graph drawer.
facts: B-3e16 migrated the standalone proof-or-stop-graph repo into packages/graph at upstream commit 10b5921de4b1fe5b4e796d1a7d78ec655cc400fd.
Upstream has four newer commits building the dossier: 4c3bde0, 7ecad9a, a0b14da, 1536588.
git diff --stat 10b5921 HEAD upstream is 7 files and 1860 insertions; 1119 of those lines are the new src/shells/web/dossier.js.

packages/graph/src/io/http.ts, src/shells/web/app.body.html, app.css and app.js are byte-identical to upstream 10b5921 here, verified by shasum, so the upstream diffs apply without conflict resolution.
packages/graph/README.md diverges by design: this repo says proof-or-stop graph rather than proof-or-stop-graph and has a How the CLI reaches this package section.
packages/graph/scripts/build-web.mjs carries an uncommitted local change making a missing d3 a hard failure, which the upstream diff does not contain.
Upstream serves the dossier by matching /story/<id> in the existing / and /index.html branch of io/http.ts and returning the same app.html; the client reads location.pathname at boot.
dossier.js self-registers window.openStoryDossier and must load after app.js, the same contract playback.js already uses in scripts/build-web.mjs.
The graph command is a normal registered handler in packages/main/src/handlers/graph.ts, long-running like serve, with a watchdog heartbeat.
The handler already refuses an unresolvable --root before listening rather than serving an empty graph.
The catalog convention is an optional Zod field with the default documented in the description, never .default(), because the help renderer detects optionality via instanceof ZodOptional.
resolveStories is exported from packages/graph/src/index.ts and returns a Resolved whose primary maps story id to directory.
Status returned by createApp().getStatus() carries only counts, not story ids, so it cannot validate an id on its own.
packages/graph is not an npm workspace; its node_modules and assets are gitignored build output, and the handler already builds the client on demand.
constraints: The dossier is ported as authored upstream, not redesigned.
The local d3 hard-failure change in build-web.mjs must be preserved while adding the dossier.js concatenation.
This repository's README wording must survive the README port; only the dossier material is added.
The new flag must follow the existing catalog convention: optional, default documented in the description, applied in the handler.
An unknown --story id must be refused before startServer, matching the existing --root precedent.
packages/graph requires Node >= 22.5 because the index uses node:sqlite.
The graph command must stay read-only with respect to story state and must not write into the inspected repository.
Only one long-running command shape: no second server command competing for the same port.
